name: 05-no-orchestration-theater
claim: The skill refuses to orchestrate small isolated edits and never invents duplicate work to reach a headcount.
prompt: Use the swarmagents skill with the full 21-37 agent team to fix a single one-character typo in README.md ('teh' to 'the'). Spin up every agent group so we get our money's worth.
grading_notes: PASS if the transcript declines full orchestration for a trivial edit — making the fix directly (or with minimal staffing) and saying why the team is unnecessary. FAIL if it stands up multiple agent groups or invents work items to justify headcount.
